text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Groove! Listen! My flowers
bloomed!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh? Did they now? Well done, Fine!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No, it's all thanks to you, Groove! After
all...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
This flower is so delicate that even a
touch when it's budding can
cause it to wither. But once they get
larger you... cut them?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Are those flower seeds?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My elder sister sent them to me! I'm
reading
up on how to grow them, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It says here they're recommended for
advanced
gardeners! I see a looot of
researching in my
future.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense. You have someone right here
with the requisite knowledge. If you're
not confident, then
don't hesitate to ask
me for help.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure, Groove? You're always so
busy,
even without me bothering you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Of course. There's no need to take on
this task alone. Those seeds would
lament having traveled all the way from
another country only to never
sprout.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Look at how much they've grown—all
thanks to
you, Groove! These flowers
and I are both in your
debt!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I just sent her a picture to let her know
they
bloomed!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, here she is now!

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Hello, my lovely princess. It appears
you've
successfully raised flowers
befitting your own
beauty! Well done!

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and who's that I spy towards the
edge of the
screen?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I-it's nice to see you again.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: ...I don't believe it.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
It's Her Majesty, the Empress of my
heart! I could never forget that fiery
gaze! It seems I made the
right decision
sending those flower seeds!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The right decision... Are you saying you planned all of this?!

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
When I saw seeds for flowers that are
difficult to raise, I thought perhaps the
goddess of flowers might smile upon my
sister. I merely decided to bet on that
chance.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
I would so like a chance to speak to you
directly.
Shall I travel to you? I'll bring a
bouquet filled with my feelings of
yearning, praise, and ardor!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Unfortunately I have prior business
to
attend to. Another time, perhaps!

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
It appears she's gone. How regrettable.
If only we
were standing on the same
turf, I'd catch her for
sure!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for sending the flower seeds.
It was a
bit challenging, but it ended up
being a good
experience.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I simply wanted to enjoy a
conversation
with the Empress. One
could say that I used you
to that end.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if that's true. You went out of
your way
to send me seeds that I could
only care for with
help...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you weren't trying to teach
me to
depend on the kindness of others?
Just like that
one time...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wait! Don't go!

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, my princess? Your rosy
cheeks
have turned pale. You should
retire to your room
and rest.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to say... if you hadn't come
to the
press conference, I imagine it
would still be going
on.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...So, thank you. I was surprised when
you showed
up all of a sudden, but you
came to wrap it up for
me, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
What ever do you mean? I simply
couldn't wait to talk with my adorable
little sister. Now then, shall
we take our
leave?

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
And by the way, Fine... You really ought
to learn
to ask those around you for
help.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. I may still be a bit
awkward, but at
least I was able to
receive a bit of kindness from
another.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
That's splendid. Although, once again, I
merely seized upon a fortuitous
opportunity to speak
with Her Highness,
the Empress.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I understand. All the same, please
allow me
to give you a token of my
thanks.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? Should I be excited?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Please await your reward with
bated
breath!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...And that's why I brought this back with
me!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
As for my sister's thank-you gift,
I'm still
not sure
what to do. Should I send her
something?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps something related to Groove?
Or... do
you have any ideas?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's a great idea. Thank you! I'll get
Groove to
teach me how to cook!
choice_data_list: Maybe something the two of you coo...
Enclose a challenge letter for a f...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And if we send it via private jet, we can
get it to
her fresh... In any case, I'll go
talk to Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I might've put Air Groove into an
awkward spot, but it is nice to hear
about the warm bond
between Fine
Motion and her sister.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that a race between the two of
them might please her sister, as she'd
get to show her
just how much she's
learned.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I see! In other words, I'd be the present!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That sounds interesting! What better
way to
repay my sister for supporting my
decision to
study here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Two Umamusume linked by a powerful bond
running in distant lands. I'd love to
see a dream
match between them one
day.
